subject.title: OpenShell sandbox creation fails with current runtime-name limit

question: Which OpenShell runtime-name contract should be supported, and is the reported name generated by OpenClaw or supplied by an external sandbox configuration?
rationale: The blank report does not establish the failing input or whether expanding the limit would preserve an intended external runtime constraint, so the correct compatibility boundary requires owner judgment.

options.title: Request a focused reproduction
options.body: Ask for the runtime name, complete error, OpenShell configuration, and a current-main reproduction before selecting a code change.

options.title: Confirm generated-name ownership
options.body: If OpenClaw generates the overlong name, route a bounded normalization fix to the generator and retain the external limit.

options.title: Adjust the supported contract
options.body: If externally supplied names must be longer, define and document the compatible validation contract before changing the limit.

recommendation.title: Request a focused reproduction
recommendation.body: Ask for the runtime name, complete error, OpenShell configuration, and a current-main reproduction before selecting a code change.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned repository-member reporter and can clarify the intended runtime input and reproduction.
